name: Wintermarch
description: A red dwarf marching through the halo's cold with a frozen world, a dwarf, and a long comet. Everything here moves slowly, including the geology. The march measures time in glaciations.

stars.name: Wintermarch Dim
stars.description: An old red dwarf with a dim steady glow the ice worlds depend on. Its flare youth is billions of years behind it. The light has not changed within living memory.

planets.name: Glacial
planets.description: A nitrogen-ice world mid-march through a hundred-thousand-year freeze. Glaciers advance on schedules the surveyors publish. Nothing hurries, including the science.

dwarfPlanets.name: Marchfollower
dwarfPlanets.description: A small ice dwarf trailing the march a few light-hours behind. Its frost records every era of the long cold. Chronologists read it like a yearbook.

comets.name: Slow Parade
comets.description: A long-period comet keeping pace with the march on a thousand-year round. Its tail brightens the long nights for months. Children born under it are called parade-born.
